title: Territory index · Power plants (abf-energy 0.1.0) · generating units
description: Where each of the 164,672 generating units of energy_plants_gem_units lies in abf-boundaries v0.2.0. A unit is assigned by its point: to the country of the frame in which the point lies, and to the units of that country in which it lies, or the nearest one within 22.2 km. A point more than 22.2 km from any country takes the country GEM names. Units, not plant rows, are indexed: a unit has one type and one status, so counts and capacity add up within a type and a status.
dataset_description: Where the records of the project's world point layers lie in its boundary frame. One row for each record of three layers: the data-center records of the Atlas of Data Center Politics (9,865) and the AI data-center sites of Epoch AI (94), both from abf-dc 0.2.0, and the power generating units of Global Energy Monitor (164,672) from abf-energy 0.1.0. Each row gives the country, first-level unit and second-level unit of the record in abf-boundaries v0.2.0, the basis of the assignment and the few fields of the record that the project website needs to list and count records. The index is the project's assignment of source records to its frame, not data of the sources. The records and their DOIs do not change; when the frame gains new levels or countries, only the index is rebuilt. The GEM units sourced from TransitionZero's Solar Asset Mapper are indexed separately, in abf-energync 0.1.1, under CC BY-NC 4.0.
attribution_text: Built by AI Buildout Frontier from abf-dc 0.2.0 and abf-energy 0.1.0 on the frame abf-boundaries v0.2.0. Sources of the records: Atlas of Data Center Politics (Infrastructure Lab, National University of Singapore; CC BY 4.0); Epoch AI, AI data centers (CC BY 4.0); Global Energy Monitor, Global Integrated Power Tracker, September 2026 release (CC BY 4.0). Their attributions are given in full in the sources of the meta.json files of the indexes.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Key of the record in its layer.

fields.name: layer_id
fields.description: Layer of the record: dc_atlas_points, dc_epoch_points, energy_plants_gem_units or energy_plants_gem_tzsam_units.

fields.name: adm0
fields.description: Country of the record in the frame (unit_id of ADM0).

fields.name: adm0_basis
fields.description: How the country was assigned: field (the country the record names) or point (the country of the frame in which the point lies).

fields.name: adm0_other
fields.description: The other country, where the country the record names and the country of its point differ. Such rows are also listed in adm0_other.csv.

fields.name: adm1
fields.description: First-level unit of the record in the frame (unit_id), inside adm0.

fields.name: adm2
fields.description: Second-level unit of the record in the frame (unit_id), inside adm1.

fields.name: unit_basis
fields.description: How adm1 and adm2 were assigned: field (the unit the record names) or point (the unit of the frame in which the point lies, among the units of adm0, or the nearest such unit within 22.2 km).

fields.name: unit_note
fields.description: Why the first level that the country has in the frame is empty for this record (see null_meaning).

fields.name: adm1_point
fields.description: For a record assigned to adm0 by the country it names whose point lies inside another country: the first-level unit of that other country in which the point lies.

fields.name: adm2_point
fields.description: As adm1_point, at the second level.

fields.name: approximate
fields.description: true where the point is not a site: the town point of an Atlas or Epoch AI record, or a GEM unit whose location GEM gives as approximate.

fields.name: boundary_release
fields.description: Version of the boundary frame used: abf-boundaries v0.2.0.

fields.name: plant_name
fields.description: Name of the plant or project, as GEM gives it.

fields.name: location_id
fields.description: GEM location ID: GEM's key of the plant. All units of a plant share it.

fields.name: type
fields.description: One of GEM's eight power technology groups: coal, oil/gas, utility-scale solar, wind, hydropower, nuclear, bioenergy, geothermal.

fields.name: status_group
fields.description: GEM base status: announced, pre_construction, construction, operating, shelved, cancelled, mothballed or retired. The two inferred statuses are counted under shelved and cancelled.

fields.name: capacity_mw
fields.description: Capacity in megawatts as GEM gives it. GEM defines it as “Total nameplate capacity, or best available data, of the project, in megawatts”. For solar units, see capacity_rating.

null_meaning.adm0_other: The country the record names and the country of its point are the same, or the record has no point.
null_meaning.adm1: The record has no first-level unit: the country has no first-level units in this frame (unit_note is empty), or the reason is given in unit_note.
null_meaning.adm2: The record has no second-level unit: the country has no second-level units in this frame (only the United States, France and Norway have them in v0.2.0), or the reason is given in unit_note.
null_meaning.unit_basis: No unit below the country was assigned.
null_meaning.unit_note: Nothing is missing, or the level does not exist for the country in this frame.
null_meaning.adm1_point: The point lies in the country assigned as adm0, or the record has no point.

unit_note_descriptions.ambiguous_name: The record names a U.S. county that shares its name with an independent city of the same state, without saying which; it is counted in its state only.
unit_note_descriptions.connecticut: A Connecticut record: the Atlas gives the state's former counties, and the frame has the planning regions that replaced them; it is counted in the state only.
unit_note_descriptions.no_county_field: The record names no U.S. county; it is counted in its state only.
unit_note_descriptions.no_state: The record names no U.S. state; it is counted in the country only.
unit_note_descriptions.region_not_matched: The record gives no region, or one that matches no unit of the frame by exact name, and has no point to assign it by.
unit_note_descriptions.no_unit_near: The point lies more than 22.2 km from every unit of its country.
unit_note_descriptions.no_point: The record has no point below the country.
unit_note_descriptions.point_in_other_country: The source lists the record under one country, and its point lies inside another; see adm1_point and adm2_point.
unit_note_descriptions.region_only: The record names a first-level unit (a French region), and each row has one basis, so no second-level unit is taken from its point.

known_gaps: GEM gives an approximate location for 73,268 of the 164,672 units (44.5%), and many approximate points are shared: 134 points carry 20 or more plants each. Such a point can lie in a unit next to the plant's own. Of the 1,087 shared points with five or more plants that lie in a first-level unit, 172 are within 5 km of its boundary.

For 291 units GEM names another country than the one in which the point lies, for example in Crimea, which GEM lists under Ukraine and the frame shows under Russian control. They are assigned to the country of the point and listed for the country GEM names (adm0_other.csv).

668 units lie more than 22.2 km from every first-level unit of their country and have none (no_unit_near). Points that fall just outside the generalized outlines of their country's units get the nearest unit within 22.2 km.
A plant can have units in two units of the frame. The number of plants of a unit therefore does not add up to the number of plants of its country.
ADM1 exists in this frame for 108 countries and ADM2 for the United States, France and Norway.

verification.method: Built by script from the files of abf-energy 0.1.0 and abf-boundaries v0.2.0. The build stops if a unit is missing or appears in two country files, if the capacity by type and status differs from the layer, or if an input differs from the published file. Points are assigned with the calculation geometry of the United States and Norway and the display geometry of the frame elsewhere. A second run gives byte-identical files.
